title: Public Sector Banks
definition: Public Sector Banks (PSBs) are commercial banks in India where the central government holds a majority stake of more than 50% in the paid-up capital, acting as the backbone of India's financial inclusion, priority sector lending, and monetary transmission mechanism.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for GS Paper III (Indian Economy, Banking, Inclusive Growth, Mobilization of Resources). Frequently tested in Prelims regarding banking sector reforms, ownership thresholds, capital adequacy norms, and amalgamation history.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and operational mechanisms of Public Sector Banks.
Evaluate historical evolution, spatial distribution, governance frameworks, and consolidation phases.
Apply high-yield mnemonics and navigate tricky examiner traps in Prelims and Mains.
prerequisites: Central Bank (RBI) functions and monetary policy
